analysis_scope: Review counts and available supervision were audited before preregistration. The status, box, point and question metrics are fixed before collecting any new native responses for this comparison.

scoring_rules.box_overlap: Original-pixel rectangle IoU averaged over every reviewed proposal. Missing proposals and failures contribute zero. Also report the number at IoU >= 0.5.
scoring_rules.clarification: Literal case-sensitive Unicode equality with the approved question on all clarification-labelled cases; other outputs and failures score zero. This compares wording only.
scoring_rules.interpretation: Signed coarse boxes and points support geometric proxies. The study does not measure pixel-mask accuracy, passenger agreement with a clarification, destination confirmation, or the formal four-condition protocol.
scoring_rules.paired: Counts of both correct, pretrained only, trained only and neither for matched statuses across every case.
scoring_rules.point_distance: Euclidean distance to the signed reference point divided by the original image diagonal. Report the mean over returned proposals and their coverage, plus an all-eligible mean charging one diagonal for each missing proposal or failure.
scoring_rules.point_in_signed_box: Among all reviewed proposals, inclusive left/top/right/bottom box containment. Absent points score zero.
scoring_rules.primary_status: Fraction matching the approved status, with every failed request counted as incorrect.
scoring_rules.scope: Direct typed, original image and unchanged empty observation list. Two fixed models, all 44 cases.
scoring_rules.unit: Each reviewed frame is one case; repeated instructions stay in their assigned recording. Metrics describe this cohort.

source_audit.review_basis: Two reviewers accepted AI-assisted annotations on the original photographs and empty observed context.
